name: Chloe
source:
A long time ago, not so long ago, there was a demon king in this world. The demon lord possessed great power, with which he intended to destroy the world.

Of course, the humans living in that world desperately resisted, The battle between humans and the demon king lasted a long, long time with many casualties. But one day, a hero appeared on the side of humanity, and the battle finally came to an end.

After a fierce battle, the hero sacrificed himself to defeat the demon king.. Everyone thought that the world would not perish, that peace would come...

--But when he fell down, the Demon King laughed,

"I have a daughter. My daughter has as much power as me, no, more than that. When my daughter turns sixteen, this time the world will end."

--and sixteen years later

To protect the world, Emma must kill the demon king's daughter who emerges before she turns 16 and destroys the world. The hero's daughter heads to the tower where she was imprisoned.

She only gets one chance, only when her birthday comes in three days. In order to wait for that, the hero's daughter had to spend three days in the tower with the Demon King's daughter, but--?

[Translated from [url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/chloe.html#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
很久以前，不久前，这个世界上有一个魔王。恶魔领主拥有强大的力量，他想要毁灭世界。

当然，生活在那个世界的人类拼命抵抗，人类与魔王的战斗持续了很长很长的时间，死伤不少。但有一天，人类一方出现了一位英雄，战斗终于结束了。

经过一番激战，英雄牺牲自己，打败了魔王。所有人都以为世界不会灭亡，和平将会到来……

——但是当他倒下时，魔王笑道：

“我有一个女儿，我的女儿拥有和我一样多的力量，不，不止这些。等我女儿十六岁的时候，这一次世界就会终结。”

——十六年后

为了保护世界，艾玛必须杀死在16岁之前出现并毁灭世界的魔王之女。英雄的女儿前往囚禁她的塔楼。

她只有一次机会，只有三天后生日的时候。为了等待这一天，英雄的女儿必须和魔王的女儿一起在塔里度过三天，但是——？

[翻译自[url=http://bellkage.blog.jp/chloe.html#story]官网[/url]]
